title: Provo commission gives Vesper Amphitheater thumbs down due to traffic concerns

title: Utah’s specialty license plates receive a colorful new glow-up
summary: Utah has ditched its standard white background specialty license plate design for more black plates, along with various other colors and even picturesque scenes.
